thread:
alex: Quick heads-up — bump window in ~2h. Can we lock the merge queue and run a final green sweep? CI has been noisy on the flaky suite this week.

ci-bot: Pipeline summary for main: build=passing (10m ago), integration=passing, flaky-tests=unstable (test_infer_latency x3 failures on linux-x86). See https://ci.redwood/status/main

maria: Copying changelog stubs into the open PRs now. If you touched runtime internals, please add a short entry or ping me.

sam: pushed fix for batcher race in PR #4321; ran local repro, looked stable. Command I used: ```pytest tests/test_batcher.py::test_race -q -k batcher```

jen: please hold on any force-merges. test_infer_latency flakes under long-seq coverage, want to confirm it's quiescent before version bump. +1 on locking the queue. :eyes:

alex: ok locking merge queue in 5m. Can someone spin dedicated GPU runners for a couple of green sweeps and post results here? Tag me when you start.

sam: starting runs on gpu-dedicated-2 now, will report back. Triggering grouped jobs for the flaky suite.

ci-bot: Job triggered by @sam: greensweep/grouped-run id=98765. Logs: https://ci.redwood/jobs/98765 · started on gpu-dedicated-2

ops-bot: Merge queue set to read-only mode. Propagation ETA ~10m. I'll post when locks are in effect.

sam: first sweep 1/3 groups green, remaining failures look like flaky network deps, not the batcher fix. Rerunning with cache cleared: `./scripts/ci/clear_cache.sh && ./scripts/ci/run_group.sh greensweep`

maria: quick changelog nudge: added "runtime: fix KV cache invalidation" to PR #4321 description. Lmk if you want a different phrasing.

jen: re-ran `pytest -k test_infer_latency -q` locally, passed 6/6. I'll leave it for another CI run before we proceed.

ci-bot: Greensweep run 98765 completed: after 2 reruns, all 5 groups green. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/98765 · Summary: flaky-test suite stabilized for this run.

alex: awesome — holding merges until cutoff (T+10m), then we do the version bump and changelog finalization. Thanks for the quick turn, team :raised_hands:

sam: noted. I'll tag the bump PR and push the version bump once cutoff opens. Will also watch the canary after roll. :shipit:
